description.narrative: The project aims to further develop and update clear guidelines that will improve the overall performance of the financial market in Cambodia and prevent challenges that could derive into unsustainable growth and client over-indebtedness. Support to this project (Phase III) would enable CMA to continue the work done during phases I and II, which were also supported by FMO through the Capacity Development Program, over the next 18 months (2019-2021). The project would benefit not only one client, but an array of past, current, and prospective FMO clients in the Cambodian financial market.
